monitor.metric: sum of proc_taskinfo pti_resident_size for root and recursively observed descendants

failure_policy.hash_or_identity_mismatch: stop before the affected solver call
failure_policy.launch_or_monitoring_failure: kill the affected process group when present and stop campaign
failure_policy.timeout_memory_cutoff_unknown_or_solver_: mark the obligation unresolved and continue the fixed schedule
failure_policy.partition_sat: require preserved solver witness output; then stop that logical slot and mark later cells unrun
